title: Submodule-update validation shares a workspace with later GitHub-token publishing
title_de: Die Submodule-Update-Validierung teilt einen Workspace mit einem späteren GitHub-Token-Publishing
summary: Five open GitHub Scorecard TokenPermissionsID alerts identified write permissions declared at workflow scope. In particular, the scheduled update-submodules workflow validated remotely advanced recursive submodule content and later published a branch and pull request in the same job. The remediation keeps restrictive defaults and isolates validation from token-bearing publishing. After synchronizing with master, a task-owned Sonar `python:S6326` code-smell delivery blocker in the regression parser was corrected without changing that security invariant. The final PR tree and the resulting master tree are identical, and the original source/permission-boundary reproduction plus the exact-master workflow controls now verify the remediation.
summary_de: Fünf offene GitHub-Scorecard-TokenPermissionsID-Alerts identifizierten auf Workflow-Ebene deklarierte Schreibrechte. Insbesondere validierte der geplante Workflow update-submodules remote vorgerückte rekursive Submodule-Inhalte und veröffentlichte später in demselben Job einen Branch und Pull Request. Die Remediation behält restriktive Defaults bei und trennt Validierung vom Token-tragenden Publishing. Nach der Synchronisierung mit master wurde ein task-eigener Sonar-`python:S6326`-Code-Smell-Delivery-Blocker im Regressionsparser korrigiert, ohne diese Security-Invariante zu ändern. Der finale PR-Tree und der resultierende Master-Tree sind identisch; die ursprüngliche Source-/Permission-Boundary-Reproduktion und die exakten Master-Workflow-Controls verifizieren nun die Remediation.
observed_behavior: At c8ca0d92b630c18232b881855c4f5d1482568ea6, update-submodules.yml declared contents: write and pull-requests: write at top level, recursively checked out and advanced the Framework submodule, executed make quick-check, and then used GH_TOKEN to force-push and create a Parent pull request. cleanup-artifacts.yml and test-full-smoke-sequential.yml declared actions: write at top level; update-actions-versions.yml declared contents: write, pull-requests: write, and actions: write at top level. The GitHub Code Scanning API reported five corresponding open Scorecard TokenPermissionsID alerts.
observed_behavior_de: Bei c8ca0d92b630c18232b881855c4f5d1482568ea6 deklarierte update-submodules.yml contents: write und pull-requests: write auf Top-Level, checkte das Framework-Submodule rekursiv aus und aktualisierte es, führte make quick-check aus und nutzte anschließend GH_TOKEN zum Force-Push und zum Erstellen eines Parent-Pull-Requests. cleanup-artifacts.yml und test-full-smoke-sequential.yml deklarierten actions: write auf Top-Level; update-actions-versions.yml deklarierte contents: write, pull-requests: write und actions: write auf Top-Level. Die GitHub-Code-Scanning-API meldete fünf entsprechende offene Scorecard-TokenPermissionsID-Alerts.
expected_behavior: Every Parent workflow declares the restrictive top-level default permissions: contents: read. A job receives only the additional capability it needs. Untrusted or remotely mutable submodule content is checked out and executed only in a read-only validation job; a separate publishing job validates the selected commit, updates only the gitlink without checking out submodules, and receives contents: write plus pull-requests: write only while publishing.
expected_behavior_de: Jeder Parent-Workflow deklariert die restriktiven Top-Level-Default-Berechtigungen permissions: contents: read. Ein Job erhält nur die zusätzlich benötigte Fähigkeit. Nicht vertrauenswürdige oder remote veränderbare Submodule-Inhalte werden nur in einem schreibgeschützten Validierungsjob ausgecheckt und ausgeführt; ein separater Publishing-Job validiert den ausgewählten Commit, aktualisiert nur den Gitlink ohne Submodule auszuchecken und erhält contents: write plus pull-requests: write ausschließlich beim Publishing.
impact: A compromised or unexpected submodule update could influence the workspace before a privileged workflow operation. Top-level write permissions also enlarge the token exposure of unrelated jobs and trigger Scorecard security findings. The assessment found a plausible boundary violation, not a demonstrated token exfiltration or unauthorized repository write.
impact_de: Ein kompromittiertes oder unerwartetes Submodule-Update könnte den Workspace vor einer privilegierten Workflow-Operation beeinflussen. Top-Level-Schreibrechte vergrößern außerdem die Token-Exposition unbeteiligter Jobs und lösen Scorecard-Sicherheitsbefunde aus. Die Untersuchung fand eine plausible Grenzverletzung, keine nachgewiesene Token-Exfiltration oder unautorisierte Repository-Schreiboperation.
preconditions: The scheduled or manually dispatched update-submodules workflow runs on the protected default branch.
The Framework submodule remote advances to a commit selected by git submodule update --remote --recursive.
The workflow job later performs GitHub-token-authenticated branch and pull-request publishing.
reproduction: Observe top-level contents: write and pull-requests: write, recursive submodule checkout/update, make quick-check, and later GH_TOKEN-backed push and pull-request steps in one job.
Query the GitHub Code Scanning API for open Scorecard alerts and observe TokenPermissionsID alerts 2 through 6 described in the retained evidence record.

evidence.command: rtk gh api 'repos/Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-conector/code-scanning/alerts?tool_name=Scorecard&state=open&per_page=100' and rtk cat .github/workflows/update-submodules.yml
rtk gh pr view 54 --repo Easton97-Jens/ModSecurity-conector and rtk gh run view for exact head a9719b89f5a37f6added5b10920eccbd0e405217
rtk make check-ci-security-contract; rtk git diff --check origin/master..HEAD; rtk gh pr checks 54 --required; GitHub Checks API; SonarCloud Quality Gate and open-issue API
rtk git rev-parse/diff/grep; rtk make check-ci-security-contract; rtk gh pr view/run list/api Scorecard alerts for PR #54 and master 63819e416984294792bbbe68aa5d84503791baab

root_cause: Write permissions were granted at workflow scope even though only individual jobs need them. update-submodules combined remote submodule selection, submodule code execution, and token-bearing publication in one workspace/job. The repository-level Actions default is write, so workflows without an explicit restrictive default would also inherit excessive authority.
root_cause_de: Schreibrechte wurden auf Workflow-Ebene vergeben, obwohl nur einzelne Jobs sie benötigen. update-submodules kombinierte Remote-Submodule-Auswahl, Ausführung von Submodule-Code und Token-tragendes Publishing in einem Workspace/Job. Der repositoryweite Actions-Default ist write, sodass Workflows ohne expliziten restriktiven Default ebenfalls übermäßige Autorität erben würden.
proposed_remediation: Set contents: read at the top level of every affected workflow. Move actions: write to isolated artifact-cleanup jobs. Scope update-actions-versions writes to its single publisher job while retaining persist-credentials: false. Split update-submodules into read-only resolution/validation and a separate minimal-permission publisher that validates the official remote commit and updates only the gitlink without checking out or executing the submodule. Add permission-contract, safe/unsafe-fixture, trust-boundary, fork-model, and SARIF-upload regression tests.
proposed_remediation_de: contents: read auf Top-Level jedes betroffenen Workflows setzen. actions: write in isolierte Artefakt-Cleanup-Jobs verschieben. Schreibrechte von update-actions-versions auf seinen einzelnen Publisher-Job begrenzen und persist-credentials: false beibehalten. update-submodules in schreibgeschützte Auflösung/Validierung und einen separaten Publisher mit Minimalrechten aufteilen, der den offiziellen Remote-Commit validiert und nur den Gitlink aktualisiert, ohne das Submodule auszuchecken oder auszuführen. Permission-Contract-, Safe/Unsafe-Fixture-, Trust-Boundary-, Fork-Model- und SARIF-Upload-Regressionstests ergänzen.
acceptance_criteria: All Parent workflow files declare exactly the restrictive top-level default contents: read.

No job with checkout, project execution, recursive submodule access, or untrusted pull-request execution has a write-scoped GitHub token, named secret, or persisted checkout credentials unless separately justified and proven safe.
update-submodules validates remote submodule content in a contents: read job and publishes only from a distinct job that does not check out or execute submodule content.
CodeQL and other legitimate SARIF uploads retain only the required security-events: write permission alongside contents: read.

The workflow-permission contract tests, safe/unsafe fixtures, actionlint, ShellCheck, zizmor, secret scanning, OSV, Scorecard, CodeQL/SARIF, and git diff --check provide the strongest applicable evidence.
validation_plan: Parse all workflow YAML through actionlint with ShellCheck integration.
Run the focused CI-security workflow contract test suite, including safe and unsafe fixtures, fork/untrusted pull-request modeling, submodule trust boundaries, and SARIF-upload permissions.
Run zizmor over production workflows and verify its insecure fixture still fails while its safe fixture passes.
Run Gitleaks, OSV, and Scorecard/CodeQL workflow checks through the focused PR and verify the exact head SHA in GitHub Actions and Code Scanning.
Run git diff --check and inspect the final Parent-only diff.
legitimate_control_tests: CodeQL, OSV, and Scorecard retain security-events: write only in SARIF-upload jobs and retain contents: read.
Artifact-cleanup jobs retain actions: write without checkout or test execution.
The update-submodules publishing job can create the expected Parent pull request after read-only validation selected a verified official remote commit.
dependencies: GitHub Actions runners and GitHub Code Scanning execute the focused PR checks.
The existing repository-level default-workflow-permissions finding FND-GITHUB-0001 remains tracked separately because changing GitHub settings is outside this Parent pull request.
residual_risk: PR #54 final head d4318cef184a1cdeb70858cc18861d7e5649037b is merged as master 63819e416984294792bbbe68aa5d84503791baab; the master tree is identical to that head, the original source/permission-boundary reproduction no longer reports TokenPermissionsID alerts, and all observed exact-master workflows, including OpenSSF Scorecard, succeeded. The repository-level default_workflow_permissions currently reads read and remaining separate Scorecard governance alerts remain tracked in FND-GITHUB-0001. No risk acceptance exists. This finding is verified, not closed; closure requires a distinct lifecycle decision.
residual_risk_de: Der finale PR-#54-Head d4318cef184a1cdeb70858cc18861d7e5649037b ist als Master 63819e416984294792bbbe68aa5d84503791baab gemergt; der Master-Tree ist mit diesem Head identisch, die ursprüngliche Source-/Permission-Boundary-Reproduktion meldet keine TokenPermissionsID-Alerts mehr, und alle beobachteten exakten Master-Workflows einschließlich OpenSSF Scorecard waren erfolgreich. Die Repository-Einstellung default_workflow_permissions liest aktuell read; verbleibende separate Scorecard-Governance-Alerts werden in FND-GITHUB-0001 verfolgt. Es gibt keine Risikoakzeptanz. Dieser Befund ist verifiziert, nicht geschlossen; ein Abschluss erfordert eine separate Lifecycle-Entscheidung.

The fix is verified, not closed.

Status, severity, confidence, release-blocker disposition, and master-verification evidence are unchanged.
